_description: Baseline parameters for the physiology-as-controller system. Values derived from expert consultations: Dr. Anna Radlicka-Borysewska (biomedical), Lt. Mateusz Stanisz (military/survival), Swiety (field practitioner). Tunable during QA phase (IPK months 08-09).

timeScale._note: 1 game day = ~40 real minutes. 30-60 minute session = ~0.75-1.5 game days.

hydration._note_scenario: From scenario: 2 glasses of water every hour during summer marches

nutrition._note_scenario: From scenario: electrolytes every 2-3 hours, magnesium 2x daily, 2-4 cereal bars per day, 1 can of food per meal break

fatigue._note_scenario: From scenario: recommended march breaks every 2-3 hours for 40-60 min. Sleep location search starts at 16:00.

wounds._note_scenario: From scenario: first aid with bandages/hydrogen peroxide for lighter wounds. Automotive first aid kits from supermarkets.

psychology._note_scenario: From scenario: after 2 weeks depression risk. Survival instinct grows with each challenge overcome. Complete loss of moral inhibitions possible for survival.

respiration._note: Jura is 300-500m ASL, no altitude issues. Cave systems may have reduced O2.

footCondition._note_scenario: From scenario: foot blisters, fungal infections from wet boots, anti-fungal spray needed. Boot maintenance during breaks.

equipment._note_scenario: From scenario part 4: 90L backpack max 25kg. Weight affects fatigue, calorie burn, march speed. DPM backpacks absorb water.

emersion._note_ipk: Critical tuning during QA: threshold for tremor, duration of mushroom effects, resource scarcity curve

spring._note_scenario: From scenario: easier fuel gathering, berries start appearing, slippery limestone

summer._note_scenario: From scenario: sleep possible without freezing, mosquito protection needed, clean rivers have trout/eel

autumn._note_scenario: From scenario: mushrooms appear September but deadly without knowledge, darkness by 19:00

winter._note_scenario: From scenario: hardest season, difficulty finding food/fire fuel, frostbite risk, need thermos with warm drinks at night
